optional_sources: Zerion positions and transactions API (API key or x402 pay-per-call)

exclusions.live_zerion_key: No Zerion API key, payment private key, or wallet address ships in this repo. The operator chooses API-key or x402 authorization and supplies the matching variables.
exclusions.demo_data_source: demo/zerion-portfolio-agent reads the synthetic portfolio and price-history fixtures; it makes no live Zerion call.

data_boundary: No repository database or hosted retention service; integrating hosts and API providers have separate policies.
evidence_boundary: Proves what surfaces and sources are wired into this build, and what was deliberately left out; does not prove those surfaces behave correctly at runtime, or that an excluded item is absent from a fork of this tree.
